In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
PGC is superior for the simultaneous analysis of C1- and oxidized products, while HPAEC is still superior for the analysis of native products.
HPAEC is still the best choice for analysis of C1-oxidized celdo-oligomers but for C4-oxidation products, PGC is the best method.
HPAEC is still the method of choice for analysis of C1-oxidized products, whereas PGC is the method of choice to analyze both C1 and C 4-oxidized oligosacchardies.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
HPAEC is still the method of choice for separation of C1-oxidized products, whereas PGC and HPLC-MS/CAD is the method of choice when C4-oxidation is to be studied.
HPAEC is still the method of choice for analysis of C1-oxidized products but that HILIC (WAX-mode) and PGC columns are the preferred methods for analysis of C4 oxidized products.
PGC is the best option for analysis of C1- and/or C4-oxidation of oligosaccharide products, but that HILIC (WAX mode) may be a better choice for C4-oxidated products alone.
The main takeaway from our work is that
PGC and WAX-HILIC are suitable for separation of intact C4-oxidation products.
the PGC column can be used for separation of intact C4-oxidation products and that HPAEC-ESI-MS is prone to chemical oxidation of C-geminal diols.
